review.reviewBody: Sam and the team at SM Heating and Air were fantastic. Quick, responsive, and extremely helpful, especially when dealing with the home warranty company. Highly recommend, would definitely use them again.

Easy to work with, efficient, friendly, did the job he said he would do, no surprises with the bill.  submits the permit on your behalf with the town you just have to pay for it and pick it up later and schedule inspection.

Was time to replace our complete Heating & Air Conditioning System (outside condensing unit, inside evaporator coil & furnace), Steve & his crew showed up on time & the job was completed in one day. They are very neat & clean & all the debris was cleaned up & removed from the job, the complete system was fully checked before they left to be sure everything was in proper working order & they checked back a few times to be certain that was still the case & there has been no issues with any aspect of the job, very pleased.

About SM Heating and Air Conditioning

SM Heating and Air Conditioning is your neighborhood HVAC company that has proudly served the greater Pequannock, NJ, area and the greater Morris County area for nearly 30 years. Our commitment to you goes beyond just keeping you comfortable—we believe in building lifelong relationships with our customers based on trust, integrity, and a genuine passion for quality service.

Honest, Reliable HVAC Experts

Finding an AC and heating company you can trust isn’t always easy. At SM Heating and Air Conditioning, we’re redefining what it means to be an HVAC contractor in North Jersey. Our team is made up of skilled, certified technicians who prioritize your comfort and safety, never cutting corners, never selling you what you don’t need.

Our Mission

We treat every customer like a neighbor, not just a number. We take pride in being the “nice guys” you can count on in Essex, Morris, and Passaic Counties. Whether we’re installing a brand new high-efficiency air conditioning system, repairing a furnace, or simply answering your maintenance questions, you’ll notice our professionalism and sincerity at every step.

Our promise is simple: Honest recommendations and upfront pricing, matched by reliable workmanship and attentive service. When you choose SM Heating and Air Conditioning, you’re getting more than expert HVAC solutions—you’re getting peace of mind.

Why Choose SM Heating and Air Conditioning?
Local Roots, Local Commitment

We’re proud to call Northern New Jersey home, and we’re committed to enhancing comfort throughout Morris County. Our understanding of the unique needs of New Jersey homes, especially with our region’s sweltering summers and freezing winters, means we can offer tailored solutions that truly work.

Certified, Experienced Technicians

Our technicians are fully licensed, insured, and professionally trained. We stay up to date on the latest heating and cooling technologies, ensuring our customers benefit from energy-efficient, cost-saving upgrades and repairs. No project is too big or small for our team. From single-family homes to small businesses, we approach every job with the same diligence and care.

“Nice Guys” Who Care

We’ve built our reputation on being the “nice guys” of HVAC. Customers regularly share stories of our courteous technicians who go the extra mile—from taking time to explain options, to respecting your home, to following up after a job is done. Our goal is to deliver the kind of customer experience we’d want for our own families.

Quality Work—Guaranteed

We only use high-quality parts and trusted brands, ensuring your systems are durable, efficient, and reliable. Our workmanship comes with a satisfaction guarantee and generous warranties, so you can feel confident your investment is protected.

Full-Service Heating & Cooling Company
HEATING REPAIR & INSTALLATION: Heaters, furnaces, and heat pumps.
AIR CONDITIONING SERVICES: Central air, ductless mini-splits, energy-efficient upgrades.
MAINTENANCE PLANS: Seasonal tune-ups keep your system running strong, all year round.

If you’re looking for a heating and air contractor in the greater Pequannock, NJ, area choose the team with a reputation for honesty and heart. Contact SM Heating and Air Conditioning today at 973-628-6472.
